messages:
asha: quick note: discovered inconsistent env var handling across SDKs. Node accepts REDWOOD_API_KEY, python sample uses RW_API_KEY, and CLI still looks for REDWOOD_KEY. confusing for k8s + sampleapp.
ben: saw this too. tutorial users export REDWOOD_API_KEY and `rw login` still prompts.
carmen: can we standardize to REDWOOD_API_KEY as canonical and accept RW_API_KEY as legacy? also explicitly document precedence: REDWOOD_API_KEY > REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY > RW_API_KEY.
av_devops-bot: k8s reminder: env names are case-sensitive; prefer UPPER_SNAKE and mount by env when possible.
asha: rotation: long-running processes don't reload env. suggest a CredProvider interface with refresh callback and an example using AWS SecretsManager/Vault. small sidecar pattern for Dedicated workers would help.
ben: tiny SDK bug: Node getDefaultKey() returns empty string if env set to "". should treat as unset. will file a test.
security: plz ensure fallback never elevates scope silently; log fallbacks and include in audit logs.
devex: next steps: update sampleapp with secret-manager example (asha), add SDK tests for empty-env & refresh (ben), doc canonical env list + precedence (carmen), security review (security).
